figurative_meaning_en: To feel or have an impression
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজকের আকাশ দেখে মনে হচ্ছে বৃষ্টি হবে।
তার কথা শুনে মনে হলো সে খুব ক্লান্ত।
example_sentences_in_english: Looking at today's sky, it seems like it will rain.
Hearing his words, I felt like he was very tired.
history: Referenced in Rabindranath Tagore's poetry, evoking a sense of endless journey and emotional depth in Bengali literature.
note: This idiom is foundational in Bengali expressive language, often used in poetic and conversational contexts.
